visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a static shot of a brightly lit indoor living room. A person lies still in a white and dark blue massage chair with gold accents, positioned against a white wall below a large window with grey horizontal blinds. In the foreground, a grey fabric sofa is visible, with a red and white patterned blanket and some pillows resting on it. (2) Suddenly, a face pops up from behind the window blinds. A person with dark hair and a black shirt is seen through the slats, shaking the blinds slightly with their hands. The person in the massage chair remains relatively still as the figure behind the window makes a sudden, startling appearance. (3) The individual behind the blinds laughs and moves around, their face clearly visible through the gaps. The person in the massage chair eventually shifts their body in reaction. The camera maintains a consistent eye-level perspective throughout the interaction, capturing the prankster's continuous laughter and gestures.
